narr: During a warm summer night with a highly unstable atmosphere (2,000 - 3, 000 J/kg CAPE), an axis of heavy rain moved across southern Indiana and north central Kentucky. This caused isolated flooding in Trimble County.
ev: US 42, near Ruby Drive, flooded and had debris in the roadway.
lsr: FLOODING AND DEBRIS IN ROADWAY ON US 42 NEAR RUBY DRIVE.
